heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly sunny. Highs from the mid 60s to around 70. North to northeast winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 15 mph in the far south.

heading: Tonight
text: Clear to partly cloudy. Lows from the mid 30s to lower 40s, except low to mid 30s in northern cold hollows, and mid to upper 40s in the Champlain Valley. Winds diminishing to light and variable, remaining north 5 to 10 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Friday
text: Patchy fog early. Otherwise mostly sunny in the morning. Remaining mostly sunny in the afternoon from the Champlain Valley north and west. Increasing high clouds elsewhere. Highs from the mid 60s to around 70. North to northeast winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 20 mph far south and in the Champlain Valley.
